description: This is a unit test class for the RegistrationEventQueueDao component, testing methods for retrieving and saving registration events in the context of the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDaoTest
classes.description: A test suite for the RegistrationEventQueueDao component, verifying CRUD operations related to registration event queues.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture, setting up required data and DAO instance.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationEventByType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of registration events by type, asserting correct event data.

methods.name: testGetUnpublishedRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Tests fetching of unpublished registration events with varying batch sizes.

methods.name: testSaveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Verifies saving of a registration event and its persistence of data and type.
